findings.finding: Concrete job loss, travel and tool use establish an ordinary worker; repeated packing and rest dilute pace.
Paid-work arrangement and initial medical assessment are real changes; much dialogue explains scope and limits.
The first completed job and actual payment supply a clear payoff; a tool demonstration changes the protagonist understanding.
A second tool lesson has incremental value, but food, washing and rest occupy much of the chapter; its explicit scene allocation already requires this rhythm.

scene_goals: 借旧工具问明白前次示范的适用条件，在严述的工作间隙完成一次具体求教。
吃一顿已经挣得的饭，安排当下生活而不挤掉休息。
让身体和受教内容都有沉淀的时间，把下一次求教留成具体而有限的打算。

successor_group.behavior: Existing frozen plan schedules tool repair, treatment and another paid cold-side job.
